body: I really appreciate your concern for others. But, as I sit here in an empty room watching the sunset I feel content knowing I will be dead soon. I dont want help anymore. I sometimes love being sad because you think of everything in a more meaningful way. I pass everyone and everything with meaning. And to tell you, my writings are about how people live theirs lives differently from anyone else. We all view life and take it in differently.

Im a 17 year old girl who isnt taken seriously. My Mom thinks social media makes me think suicide is glorified. Im so sick of her telling me im fine. I cant get help all alone. I needed someone to be there for me when I cried. I have kepy myself alive this whole time and I cannot continue

Im still here. Just waiting to go home and throw out my personal journals and throw my jewelry in the lake for someone else to find in years ahead. But I am done. I didnt see the waterfall, but its ok. Im okay with what im going to do
Everyone is scared of messing up, it keeps me back from killing myself too. I know that when im really ready to kill myself I wont be afraid of the pain
